ClearForms is the most efficient way to provide local government digital services

paragraphs: CityGrows is now ClearForms, part of ClearGov's cloud-based government software solutions that help modernize local government organizations. The product is an automated permitting platform for local government, sold as a replacement for paper, PDFs and basic online forms.

Online applications are automatically routed where they need to go. The workflow editor does not limit a buyer to predetermined permit types. The company says setting up a permitting workflow takes as little as a half hour. Its own summary is that governments can use ClearForms for just about any type of workflow.

Fire and police departments use it to bring simple processes online for staff and the public. Listed public safety uses include online employment applications meant to increase the diversity of applicant pools. Vacant property check requests are another example the company gives.
